summary: 36 units (75-110). 1 error (97 vṛṣyāḥ gender), rest minor. Main themes: Hindi conjecture prefix कल्पित→अनुमानित (82,83,85); unhedged probable identifications in translations (85 trika, 91 halīmaka, 101 dhāvanī Hindi, 105 pāṭhā); Hindi 109 'से बढ़कर' imports comparison; case labels on non-final compound members (81,88); two silent emendations unflagged (93 tt, 95 meṃḍhra). Identifications all acceptable as tagged; mahat pañcaka possibly the five great roots (probable). Open readings (88, 92, 102 sa-mastu, 106, 107, 109) left for human decision. No regrouping needed; 110 is the chapter colophon.
glossary_suggestions: Hindi for 'on a conjectural reading' is अनुमानित पाठ पर (not कल्पित).
Hindi inline hedge for a bracketed English conjecture: 'अनुमान से जोड़ा गया ...' (no brackets).
Hindi sadana (limb sinking) = थकावट, not अवसाद (depression).
anyat + ablative = 'other than' (Hindi के सिवा), not a comparative 'से बढ़कर'.
halīmaka = probably a severe stage of pāṇḍu (pāṇḍu = pale; Hindi पाण्डु यानी रक्ताल्पता), always hedged.
mahat pañcaka: probably the five great roots (bilva, agnimantha, śyonāka, pāṭalā, gambhārī); hedge if used.
Do not label case on non-final compound members; give gender only.
